<thought>We need to create an ML‑ready dataset from the consolidated polymorphs JSON using the provided parameters. The `prepare_tabular_dataset` tool will generate the training and test files plus a metadata JSON that lists the features and file locations. After running the tool we will list the output directory to locate the metadata file and return its path as the final answer.</thought>
<action>prepare_tabular_dataset</action>
<action_input>{
    "polymorphs_json_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_batch_retrieve_oxide_polymorphs_trial_14/oxide_polymorphs/consolidated_polymorphs.json",
    "output_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_14/oxide_ml_dataset",
    "target_property": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "feature_engineering": "advanced",
    "test_split": 0.2,
    "normalize": true
}</action_input>
